The subject is lounge space

Lounge Space Notice

Travelers using Aurelia Skyways with companion animals should plan for a few shared-space adjustments before departure. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping the flow calm, and our handlers will guide each traveler through the steps with a steady hand and a friendly tone. <<FACT F072>>

We are asking everyone to keep carriers closed, move at an easy pace, and leave extra room for staff who are helping pets settle in. If you are bringing a larger dog, <<FACT F057>> Please keep documents handy so the check-in path stays smooth for you and for the animal beside you.

If you need help with lounge access, pet timing, or crate placement, please come to the desk before boarding. Companion Animal Travel Desk
